City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 9, 2015 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Green Building Incentive Program recognition for one mixed-use project that achieved US Green Building Council LEED Gold certification and two single-family residential projects that achieved Build It Green GreenPoint Rated certification. Contact Person: Senior Planner Kusiak
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 8/19/15 Regular Meeting, 8/26/15 Closed Session Meeting, and 8/26/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-09-09 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-09-09 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Consideration and approval of FY2014-15 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CAPER) for the Community Development Block Grant and HOME Investment Partnership programs. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
Approve the report and authorize submission to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.
2015-09-09 Item 8C - CDBG & HOME Programs
8D.
Treasurer's Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2015 and adoption of Investment Policy. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
1) Receive and file the Treasurer's Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2015; and 2) Adopt the investment policy.
2015-09-09 Item 8D - Treasurer's Annual Report
8E.
Adoption of Resolution 2015-57; Permit fee waiver for residential graywater systems. Contact Person: Management Analyst Noel
1) Consider the information in the Agenda Report; 2) Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and, 3) Approve Resolution 2015-57, which will waive fees for residential graywater system permits.
2015-09-09 Item 8E - Graywater Permit Waivers
8F.
Revision to Section II.A.5 of Council Policy C003 - Policies & Protocols for City Council Meetings to allow the use of iPads to access the electronic agenda during Council Meetings. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the revision to Section II.A.5 of Council Policy C003 - Policies & Protocols for City Council Meetings.
2015-09-09 Item 8F - City Council Policy C003 Update (UPDATED Page 4)
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to meet with applicants, discuss and make one appointment to fill the unscheduled vacancy on the Parks and Recreation Commission with a term ending March 2017. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on the Parks and Recreation Commission; Council discussion; and Mayor, with the approval of the City Council make one appointment to fill an unscheduled vacancy on the Parks and Recreation Commission with a term ending March 2017.
2015-09-09 Item 10A - Parks and Rec Unscheduled Vacancy
10B.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-12, which establishes regulations for Group Homes, including Sober Living Homes, in single family residential zones. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Municipal Code (Title 30, Title 9 and Title 2); the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans; and the Local Coastal Program. Case Number: 15-156 POD. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Receive the staff report; 2) Open the public hearing and receive and consider public testimony; and, 3) Introduce, draft Ordinance No. 2015-12 titled, "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Adopting Amendments to Title 30, Title 9, and Title 2 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Downtown Encinitas, North 101 Corridor, Encinitas Ranch, and Cardiff-by-the-Sea Specific Plans" as reflected in Attachment A for the reasons specified in the Agenda Report. Staff recommends that the Council delay the second reading until the conclusion of the Costa Mesa lawsuit regarding their Ordinance No. 14-13.
2015-09-09 Item 10B - Sober Living Ordinance
10C.
North Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project (CS04D) Design Contract Amendments with Michael Baker International and MW Peltz and Associates. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Authorize the City Manager to amend the contract with Michael Baker International (formerly RBF) as necessary to complete 100% civil engineering plans for Phase II (North Court to La Costa Ave.) of the N. Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project, in an amount not to exceed $376,000.00; 2) Authorize the City Manager to amend the contract with MW Peltz and Associates as necessary to complete 100% landscape and irrigation plans for Phase II (North Court to La Costa Ave.) of the N. Coast Highway 101 Streetscape Project, in an amount not to exceed $250,000.00; and, 3) Discuss and provide direction to staff regarding the option to authorize revisions to the project EIR, Traffic Impact Analysis, and 30% level drawings to include the potential parking areas at three key locations on the east side of North Coast Highway 101. If desired, authorize the Director of Finance to allocate $140,000.00 of General Fund monies to Project CS04D for the additional design expenses, and authorize the City Manager to amend the Michael Baker International civil engineering design contract as necessary to revise the project EIR, Traffic Impact Analysis, and 30% level drawings to include the potential parking areas, in an amount not to exceed $140,000.00.
2015-09-09 Item 10C - Streetscape Phase II Design
PLEASE NOTE THAT AGENDA ITEMS 10D AND 10E WILL BE CONTINUED TO THE SEPTEMBER 16, 2015 CITY COUNCIL MEETING
10D.
Public Hearing to consider the introduction of Draft City Council Ordinance No. 2015-05, which proposes changes to the City's density bonus ordinance to implement California density bonus law. The proposed ordinance will amend the City's Zoning Ordinance and Local Coastal Program. Project #14-202 POD. Contact Person: Planning and Building Director Murphy
THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO THE SEPTEMBER 16, 2015 CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
2015-09-09 Item 10D - Density Bonus Ordinance (Continued from 8-26)
10E.
City Council reconsideration of actions taken on July 16, 2014 relating to the application and/or interpretation of the City's policies and state density bonus law. Contact Person: Barbara Kautz, Special Counsel
THIS ITEM WILL BE CONTINUED TO THE SEPTEMBER 16, 2015 CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
2015-09-09 Item 10E - Density Bonus Policy Reconsideration
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-09-09 Item 15 - City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
